specification: For any owner, caller, generation, extent and state. Each transition refuses in a fixed order: wrong owner, stale generation, wrong state, exhausted generation; every refusal leaves the lifecycle equal to what it was. A success advances the generation by one, enters the state the table names and replaces the extent only on reconfigure and resume. Retirement never fails on exhaustion: the generation saturates and the state alone closes it. retire_current differs from retire only in carrying no generation. Along any trace of these transitions the owner never changes and generations never fall; two moments where one generation may render are the same state, extent included; a retired lifecycle never changes again, so no generation renders again.
assumptions: Traces are sequences of calls on one exclusively held value: Rust ownership, not proved here.
Verus default integer model, not a cross-platform execution test.

Verus+Z3.model_note: The count includes the re-verified dependencies. Twelve wrong implementations and two weakened trace steps are refused; the two weakened steps show that the trace theorems are not vacuous.
